data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 4.1m (2020: GBP 2.2m strengthening) was experienced during the year.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2019 year of account prior claims development
prior_year_events.impact_description: Positive prior year claims development benefiting the 2019 year of account (release of GBP 1.3m during 2021).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was GBP 32.968m. During 2021 the Syndicate experienced a favourable prior-accident-year run-off giving a release of GBP 4.1m, driven by favourable claims development (including a noted GBP 1.3m positive prior year development on the 2019 year of account). The movement reduced gross reserves and benefited the closed years; the Syndicate writes long-term life/term business (reported as long-term insurance business) and the release is reported at a syndicate-wide level.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 4.1m (2020: GBP 2.2m strengthening) was experienced during the year.
positive prior year claims development of GBP 1.3m occurring during 2021
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement sourced from Note 5 narrative which reports a GBP 4.1m prior-accident-year release; the note does not explicitly label the amount 'gross' vs 'net', but it is presented in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note and is treated as gross. The syndicate writes long-term life/term business (not a named Lloyd's LOB); 'Accident & Health' used as closest mapping. Gross premium mix is a single-line summary 'long-term insurance business' from the segment note. Claims development triangle is available (gross) and was used as a cross-check.
